title: IREN Microsoft Deal Recasts Crypto Miner As Emerging AI Infrastructure Player
title_zh: IREN 微软交易将加密矿工重塑为新兴人工智能基础设施参与者
summary: IREN (NasdaqGS:IREN) has secured a $9.7b, 200 MW infrastructure agreement with Microsoft to supply capacity for AI workloads. The deal supports IREN's shift away from a pure crypto mining focus toward broader AI infrastructure services.
summary_zh: IREN（纳斯达克股票代码：IREN）已与微软签订了价值 9.7 亿美元、200 兆瓦的基础设施协议，为人工智能工作负载提供容量。该交易支持 IREN 从纯粹的加密货币挖矿重点转向更广泛的人工智能基础设施服务。

title: Alphabet Inc. (GOOG) Announces Completion of its Acquisition of Wiz
title_zh: Alphabet Inc. (GOOG) 宣布完成对 Wiz 的收购
summary: Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG) is one of the most profitable blue chip stocks to invest in now. Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOG) announced the completion of its acquisition of Wiz on March 11.
summary_zh: Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）是目前投资最赚钱的蓝筹股之一。 Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）于 3 月 11 日宣布完成对 Wiz 的收购。

title: A 'dividend' for your crypto? Wall Street's newest way to sweeten the deal for ETF holders
title_zh: 您的加密货币的“红利”？华尔街为 ETF 持有者提供便利交易的最新方式
summary: Crypto investors are turning to yield-bearing digital asset products.
summary_zh: 加密货币投资者正在转向有收益的数字资产产品。

title: Trump administration reportedly set to be paid $10bn for brokering TikTok deal
title_zh: 据报道，特朗普政府将因促成 TikTok 交易而获得 100 亿美元的报酬
summary: Exceptionally rare ‘fee’ to be paid by investors who took control of US operations from Chinese parent company
summary_zh: 从中国母公司手中控制美国业务的投资者需要支付极其罕见的“费用”

title: Salesforce AI Deal With Adecco Highlights Agentforce Potential And Valuation Gap
title_zh: Salesforce AI 与 Adecco 的交易凸显了 Agentforce 的潜力和估值差距
summary: Adecco Group has begun a global deployment of Salesforce Agentforce 360 and Voice across its recruitment operations. The expanded, multi-year partnership is designed to support a large scale, human centric AI transformation in how Adecco recruiters work.
summary_zh: Adecco Group 已开始在其招聘业务中全球部署 Salesforce Agentforce 360​​ 和 Voice。此次扩大的多年合作伙伴关系旨在支持德科招聘人员工作方式的大规模、以人为本的人工智能转型。
